scripts.bundle:app: NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/npm-cache npm run tauri -- build --bundles app && bash scripts/sign-app.sh
scripts.verify:app: bash -c 'codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=4 src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Harpoon.app && codesign -d --entitlements :- src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Harpoon.app/Contents/Resources/harpoon/bin/harpoon | grep -q com.apple.security.virtualization && ! codesign -d --entitlements :- src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Harpoon.app/Contents/MacOS/harpoon-desktop | grep -q com.apple.security.virtualization && echo "verify:app PASS"'
scripts.verify:dmg: bash -c 'ls src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | xargs -I{} sh -c "hdiutil attach -nobrowse -quiet \"{}\" && echo \"verify:dmg PASS\" && hdiutil detach /Volumes/Harpoon 2>/dev/null || echo \"verify:dmg mount blocked (sandbox)\"" || echo "no dmg found"'
